openings.claim: Pencilled pattern quantities and exterior pattern names extend existing tags/samples; marking only after filling may prevent omissions and assignment exchanges.
openings.discriminator: Shared trays plus checks outperform incumbent; local materials without checks outperforming correctly used checks challenges quantity confusion.
openings.probe: Compare matched pattern counts across incumbent, shared/checklist and local/no-check batches; alternate order and independently audit contents, total time and reaches.
openings.uncertainty: Exact quantities must be available; writing/checking overhead and full-run transfer remain unknown.

openings.claim: Shared-tray contention may interrupt picking; crossing reaches and shared-material omissions fit this explanation.
openings.discriminator: Local placement reduces omissions with identical pattern sequences; fewer reaches without fewer omissions defeats the proposed mechanism.
openings.probe: Alternate matched six-kit shared/local blocks; reverse order between volunteers, verify footprint and record discrepancies before correction.
openings.uncertainty: The twelve-kit loose batch had no omissions in 15 minutes, but its mixture is unknown; reduced contention is unproven.

openings.claim: Pattern switching during filling may interfere with overlapping quantity rules; infrequent sample use fits, while reaches may be incidental.
openings.discriminator: Omissions persist despite fewer reaches at matched switching; consistently eliminating omissions at unchanged switching/sample use defeats this explanation.
openings.probe: Use D2 comparison and additionally tally pattern switches and sample consultations.
openings.uncertainty: A simpler loose-batch sequence is hypothetical; whether errors arise during picking or filling remains unknown.

lineage.reason: Retains quantity checks and exterior assignment guidance.
Retains switching alternative and shared probe.

decision: Probe competing explanations; synthetic stipulations demonstrate no effects. Preserve specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, all preparation/assembly/checking within 90 minutes, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing envelopes/supplies only. Success requires 60 assigned kits ready with at most one distribution correction. Open-packet footprint, later supply depletion and full-run feasibility remain unresolved.
